retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait of a stylish man in formal wear set against a blurred, vibrant city nightscape with bold, metallic display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a black tuxedo and white scarf positioned on the left, contrasted against a deep-perspective view of a city street at night filled with colorful bokeh lights and glowing signage.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center to the left to balance the deep city perspective on the right.
High-contrast white scarf and red tie against a dark suit and night background.
Bold, metallic display text anchored at the top, spanning the width of the frame.
Warm skin tones and red accents popping against a cool, dark urban backdrop.
coreInvariants: Deep perspective city street with bokeh light effects.
Subject in formal attire with a prominent white scarf.
Metallic, beveled, or chrome-effect display typography at the top.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the left third of the frame, scaled to approximately 70% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's white scarf provides a bright vertical anchor that draws the eye immediately.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright white scarf, moves up to the bold metallic title, then follows the city street perspective down into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark areas of the night sky and the subject's suit provide negative space that makes the lights and text pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues of the night sky and suit.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the scarf and city lights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red of the tie and script text, plus yellow and cyan bokeh.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and bright highlights; saturated primary colors in the lights and accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold extended sans-serif and elegant formal script.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy horizontal weight with a metallic chrome bevel effect.
Horizontal pinstripe texture applied across the main title glyphs.
Secondary text uses a high-contrast, slanted formal script with flourishing loops.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main title letters feature a 3D extrusion effect with a gold-to-silver gradient.
Script text features exaggerated descenders and ascenders.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, industrial metallic sans-serif paired with delicate, organic red script for a 'tough but smooth' aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Horizontal scan-line texture on main text

preserve: Extended width of the main title
avoid: Flat matte colors for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, wide proportions of the main title.
Captures the formal, high-contrast script style of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man in a black tuxedo, red tie, and white scarf on the left side of the frame. The background should be a long-exposure, high-perspective view of a city street at night with colorful bokeh lights and glowing signs.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, all-caps, ultra-extended metallic title at the top with horizontal pinstripe textures. Below it, add a red calligraphic script subtitle.

verificationChecks: Is the subject on the left side?
Is the city background showing deep perspective?
Does the main title have a metallic, striped texture?
Is the script text red and calligraphic?

adjustableVariables: Color of the tie and script text
Width of the main title font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the white scarf is the brightest element on the subject.
Ensure the city lights have a soft, circular bokeh quality.
Verify the metallic text has a 3D beveled appearance.
Confirm the red script is legible against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Nightlife Portrait + Metallic Extended Sans + Red Calligraphic Script
